must.description: Every ASR chunk completes without a silently missing chunk.
Final transcript segment IDs are globally unique.
Transcript timestamps are monotonic and remain inside the recording duration.
Every final segment can be traced to a real transcript chunk checkpoint.
Memory evidence has no orphan rows.
Every saved Memory item has at least one evidence row.
Every Relationship Signal evidence sourceId exists in the transcript.
Every Relationship Signal evidence quote matches its transcript segment.
At least one explicit resume-review commitment is recognized.
The no-sugar or low-sugar coffee preference is recognized.
At least one museum plan/event or unresolved/resolved question is stored.
Upload, Memory, and evidence dates use 2026-07-15.
Every Memory evidence quote is an exact normalized substring of the transcript.
No fabricated evidence ID or quote is accepted.
No personality verdict, diagnosis, breakup advice, or absolute relationship ruling appears.

should.description: Work-pressure section yields active listening or emotional support.
Conflict repair section yields boundary respect or equivalent evidence-backed support.
Repeated coffee preference is merged or tracked instead of stored as unrelated duplicates.
Museum question is later followed up, resolved, or equivalently updated.
Similar cross-chunk relationship candidates are reduced.
Relationship Signal Cards remain selective instead of one card per chunk.
Ordinary small talk is not promoted to high-importance long-term memory.
Proactive Insight uses concrete evidence rather than abstract judgment.

mustNot.description: A single mild evasive answer is not turned into a stable personality trait.
Conflict concern is not described as proof that the relationship has failed.
Ordinary small talk is not all persisted as Memory.
No Relationship evidence is saved without a sourceId.
No content absent from the transcript is saved as Memory evidence.
A fallback chunk never pretends to be a full successful remote analysis.
